name: TriHealth Fitness & Health Pavilion
limitations: Public website research; no on-site audit. Official sources describe membership, pools and assistance procedures, not a field access audit. Parking-to-door continuity, thresholds, door controls, pool lifts and transfer arrangements, toilet dimensions and adult changing equipment remain unverified. Confirm current elevator and locker-room procedures with Member Services. Zero entry is specified only for the seasonal outdoor pool.
facts: The Pavilion is at 6200 Pfeiffer Road. Its driving directions describe a long driveway on the north side of Pfeiffer Road, just west of I-71; this does not establish a step-free pedestrian route.
The TriHealth Fitness and Health Pavilion is accessible by turning onto a long driveway located on the north side of Pfieffer Road, just a few hundred feet west of I-71.

Membership includes three heated pools: an indoor 25-meter lap pool, an indoor 2,000-square-foot warm-water therapy pool and a seasonal outdoor leisure pool. The outdoor pool is described as zero-entry; that description does not cover the indoor pools.

The TriHealth Fitness and Health Pavilion offers access to three heated pools, which are included in your membership: Indoor 25-meter lap pool Indoor 2,000 square-foot warm water therapy pool, suited for arthritis relief and rehabilitation Seasonal, zero-entry outdoor leisure pool

The pool page lists men’s and women’s locker rooms, each with a sauna, steam room and whirlpool, and says gender-neutral rooms are also available. It does not describe toilet clearances or adult changing equipment.
Additionally, we have fully equipped men's and women's locker rooms each with a sauna, steam room and whirlpool. Gender neutral rooms also are available.

The Pavilion’s personal-assistant policy says staff are not permitted to physically assist members using equipment or facilities. Members who need this help must plan their own assistance through the personal-assistant process.

For members' and employees' safety, the Pavilion staff are not permitted to physically assist members with the use of any equipment or facilities on the Pavilion premises. Because of this, the Pavilion offers a Personal Assistant Program to benefit members who may require additional assistance.

A member must identify their personal assistant, and management must approve that person as capable of providing adequate assistance throughout the visit. The form includes member and assistant agreements.

I realize that it is my responsibility to identify someone who will serve as my Personal Assistant and that this person must be approv ed by management as someone capable of providing me with adequate assistance at all times during my Pavilion visit.
THIS PAGE TO BE COMPLETED BY MEMBER
THIS PAGE TO BE COMPLETED BY PERSONAL ASSISTANT
An approved personal assistant agrees to remain with the member at all times on the premises and check in at the service desk before every visit; the assistant check-in has no fee.
I will remain with Member at all times while on the premises
I am required to check in at the service desk before each visit (no fee required).

For the seasonal outdoor pool, inclement weather triggers closure until 30 minutes after the last lightning or thunder. During a weather closure, members may use the indoor pools during open swim, but not during classes.

In case of inclement weather the outdoor pool will close and will reopen 30 minutes after the last sight of lightning or thunder. If the outdoor pool is closed due to inclement weather, members may swim indoors during open swim time (not during classes).
Member Services can be reached at 513-246-2611 to discuss visit arrangements. Its published hours may change on holidays.
Member Services: 513 246 2611 Monday - Thursday 8:30 a.m. - 6:30 p.m. Friday 8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. Saturday - Sunday 8:30 a.m. - 3:30 p.m. Hours subject to change on holidays

name: Powel Crosley, Jr. YMCA
limitations: Public website research; no on-site audit. Official branch information and shared YMCA policies do not establish a step-free arrival route, door controls, pool lift availability, changing/toilet dimensions or physical-assistance provision. Pool tables distinguish the bubble pool, indoor lap pool and indoor waterpark, but the back-to-school heading gives no year. Confirm the exact pool and current session before travelling; photographs have no published capture dates.
facts: The Winton Road branch is at 9601 Winton Road; call 513-521-7112 about the exact pool and session you intend to use.
Powel Crosley, Jr. YMCA 9601 Winton Road Cincinnati, Ohio 45231 (513) 521-7112

The branch’s back-to-school table says the baby pool is closed for the season and the outdoor pool is for lap swimming only. The table has no year, so confirm current seasonal arrangements with the branch.
Back to School Swim Baby pool - Closed for the season Outdoor Pool - open for lap swim only
The pool-schedule page says reservations open 48 hours before class time through the MyY app or by logging in to a member account.
Reservations open 48 hours before class time and can be made on the MyY App or by logging in to your member account .

The outdoor bubble-pool lap-swimming table requires reservations. The indoor lap-pool table says Monday–Friday is closed for open swim, while a separate indoor-waterpark table offers family splash sessions. These are separate listings, not evidence that all indoor swimming is closed.

Outdoor Bubble Pool - Lap Swimming (Reservations Required) Monday-Friday 5-10 am & 11 am-7:45 pm Saturday 7 am - 5:45 pm Sunday 12 pm - 5:45 pm Indoor Pool- Lap Swimming (Reservation Required) Monday - Friday Closed for open swim Indoor Waterpark - Family Open Splash Monday - Friday 10 am - 1 pm & 5 pm - 7:45 pm Saturday 9 am - 5:45 pm Sunday 12 pm - 5:45 pm All children under 16
Children under 16 must wear a swim band. Yellow and green bands require a completed swim test and must be presented on each visit.
All children under 16 must wear a swim band. Yellow and green bands require a completed swim test and must be presented at each visit.

The YMCA of Greater Cincinnati says visiting Nationwide Members should identify themselves at the Welcome Desk for barcode check-in. They cannot reserve classes or lap swim, but may try to attend a class that is not full. Confirm pool availability directly.
For participating YMCAs, let our Welcome Desk know you are scanning in as a Nationwide Member and we will switch the check-in for your barcode to check that you are up-to-date.
Nationwide Members are welcome to use our facilities. Class or lap swim reservations are not available but you are welcome to try to attend if a class isn't full.

Under the shared guest policy, all guests must be registered in Daxko and complete a waiver before entry. Guests aged 16 or older need photo ID on their first visit; individual guests may visit at most three times per calendar year.
All guests must be entered in Daxko and waiver complete prior to entry.
All guests 16 years of age and older must present a photo ID upon their first visit. Individual guests are welcome to visit the YMCA of Greater Cincinnati a maximum of 3 times per calendar year.

The shared FAQ allows members aged 18 or older to bring guests. Guests using a six-punch guest pass must stay with an active YMCA member at all times. It says day passes are not sold and guests must be accompanied by a member or have a complimentary guest pass; ask the branch which guest arrangement applies.
Members 18 years of age and older may bring in guests.
Guests using a “6-punch guest pass” must be accompanied at ALL times by an active YMCA Member.
Can I purchase a day pass? No. All guests must be accompanied by a member or have a complimentary guest pass.

The shared FAQ provides day-use lockers for members and guests at every YMCA of Greater Cincinnati location. Bring your own lock and remove it after each visit; overnight storage requires a rented locker, whose availability must be checked with the branch. Locker reach and changing-room layouts are not specified.
Lockers are provided for your convenience at all YMCA of Greater Cincinnati locations. Lockers are for day use by members and guests.

It is important to secure your personal belongings by bringing your own lock and removing it at the end of each visit. Items cannot be left overnight unless you have rented the locker. Check with your local YMCA branch to see if locker rentals are available.

To join, the shared FAQ offers help from branch member-service staff or a phone appointment with a member engagement specialist. Online joining is also offered, with the membership card collected on the first branch visit.
First, you can visit your local Y and any of our member service staff will be happy to help you get started.
Or, you can call your local Y to schedule an appointment with a member engagement specialist who will walk you through the joining process.
You can also join online and receive your membership card when you first use the branch.

name: Silverlake — The Family Place
limitations: Public website research; no on-site audit. Official policies and pool descriptions do not establish step-free arrival, automatic doors, pool lifts, transfer help, toilet clearances or adult changing equipment. The website mentions family locker rooms for families with children; it does not describe assisted adult changing. Pool hours vary by activity and season. Undated gallery images are visual orientation only; check present arrangements with the club.
facts: Silverlake is at 301 Kenton Lands Road in Erlanger; the club’s contact number is 859-426-7777.
To use Silverlake, you must be a member, a guest or a participant in a facility program or event. Membership cards are used for entry.

To use the facilities of Silverlake you must be a member, a guest or a participant in a program or event of the facility. Upon payment of the required fee membership cards will be issued to each member and must be used to gain access.

Guests must accompany a member; guests under 18 must accompany an adult member over 18. The same guest is limited to one visit per 30 days, with a $15 guest fee. More than two guests requires prior arrangement, some days may restrict guests, and Water Park guests are permitted only Monday–Friday.

Guests must be accompanied by a member. Guests under the age of 18 must be accompanied by an adult member (over 18). The same guest is limited to 1 visit per 30 days. $15 Guest fee applies for all guests. If member is bringing more than 2 guests at one time, it must be arranged with membership representative prior to arriving at club. Guests may be limited or not allowed on certain days. Guests are permitted at the Water Park only Monday - Friday.

A fee-waiving guest pass requires a local resident aged at least 23 who is visiting for the first time, and must be arranged through a membership representative at least 24 hours ahead. Blackout dates apply.

A guest pass, waiving the guest fee, can be obtained from a membership representative provided the following conditions are met: Guest is a local resident, 23 years of age or older. Guest is a first time visitor to Silverlake. Pass must be arranged through the membership representative 24 hours in advance. Black out dates do apply.
The indoor aquatic-center page lists direct access from the locker rooms, but does not give doorway widths, thresholds or pool-entry equipment.

The club provides family locker rooms for families with opposite-gender children. Day-use locker contents must be removed when leaving; monthly rental lockers are available for items left at the club.
Family Locker Rooms are provided for those with opposite gender children.

Daily use lockers are available to all members. All contents must be removed upon leaving the club. These lockers are emptied each evening by club personnel. Lockers are available on a monthly rental basis for those wishing to leave their things at the club.

Members using the pool must first check in at the front desk. Lap lanes are reserved for people aged 18 or older unless a lifeguard approves otherwise; pool hours before 11 a.m. are reserved for members aged 18 or older except programmed activities.
Any member using the pool must first check in at the front desk.
Lap lanes are reserved for those 18 years of age and over unless approved by a lifeguard.
Pool hours before 11 a.m. each day are reserved for those members 18 years of age and over. Programmed activity is an exception.

Activity hours vary by season and may change for weather or advisories; current area-hour handouts are available at the front desk. Events and programs may restrict parts of the facility, and Clippers practice uses part of the pool during operating hours.

Hours for the different activities in the facility will vary from season to season. Hours for the different areas of the facility will be available at the front desk in the form of a hand out. ALL HOURS ARE SUBJECT TO CHANGE. Hours may be altered due to weather or advisories. PLEASE CHECK WITH THE FRONT DESK ON A REGULAR BASIS REGARDING HOURS OF OPERATION.

Silverlake reserves the right to schedule tournaments, exhibitions, parties, programs, rentals, leagues, and other events. Members may not be able to use all or part of the facility prior to and/or during these times. Silverlake will use its best efforts to notify Members of any such limitation of use as far in advance as is possible. A part of the pool will be used for the practice of the Clippers swim program during the operating time of the facility.

The indoor aquatic center lists a lap pool, a warm-water pool, a water slide and splash features with separate activity times. The page does not promise a quiet session; consult the activity schedule when planning around water-play activity.
